structure_policy_rationale: Following the 'douyin' and 'alipay' reference patterns, the core logo geometry must be strictly preserved to maintain brand recognition. The transformation is purely material (flat red vector -> 3D ice sculpture) and dimensional (adding Z-axis thickness), without altering the silhouette or internal proportions.
preserve: The exact outer boundary curve of the organic blob shape
The central triangular play button cutout (negative space)
The relative position of the play button within the mass
The specific lower-left inward concave curve characteristic
must_preserve: The exact outer boundary curve of the red shape
The triangular hole in the center
Internal bubbles/snowflake textures within the ice volume
recompose_allowed: Edge highlights (specular reflections to define the 3D form)
Base contact shadow and melting water puddle
Internal refraction and subsurface scattering effects
restyle: Convert original flat red vector to translucent pale cyan/ice-blue 3D volume
Replace solid color with crystalline ice material containing micro-bubbles and snowflakes
Round off sharp vector edges to mimic eroded/polished ice contours
decorate: Embed stylized snowflake patterns within the ice volume
Add scattered water droplets (condensation) on the surface
Apply glossy specular highlights on upper edges
Add subtle ground shadow and small water puddle at base
forbid: Flattening the icon into a 2D blue shape
Changing the organic blob shape into a perfect circle, square, or standard geometric shape
Using opaque plastic, metal, or stone materials
Depicting realistic watermelon slices or fruit imagery
Complex background scenes (must be clean white)
generation_brief: 3D icon of Xigua Video logo as a thick translucent ice sculpture. Pale cyan/ice-blue material with internal bubbles and embedded snowflakes. Glossy wet surface with condensation droplets. Strictly preserve the irregular organic blob outline and central triangular play cutout. White background with soft contact shadow and water puddle at base. No red colors, no flat vectors.
color_application: Discard original high-saturation red. Apply uniform pale cyan/ice-blue palette. Use lightness variations only to define 3D volume and refraction, not brand identity.
stroke_application: Eliminate all 2D strokes. Define edges through 3D volume, light refraction, and specular highlights. Ensure contours are smooth, rounded, and beveled like worn ice.
composition_application: Center the 3D ice object occupying 60-70% of canvas. Add Z-axis thickness to the flat logo. Anchor with a subtle ground shadow and water puddle on a pure white background.
identity_application: Maintain strict fidelity to the unique asymmetrical organic silhouette and the central negative-space triangle. Identity is conveyed solely through shape preservation, as color is standardized to the theme.
fidelity_constraints: Must use unified ice-blue semi-transparent material
Must include internal bubbles, snowflakes, or ice crack textures
Must present clear 3D volumetric presence with subsurface scattering
negative_constraints: No distortion of the core organic blob silhouette
